title: Recent advances in TEAD modulators: A medicinal chemistry perspective.
authors: Hu, Naixin; Wang, Qi; Xu, Dounan; Luo, Cheng; Xiong, Huan
one_liner_zh: 该文综述TEAD转录因子调节剂的药物化学进展，虽涉及TF-DNA相关体系但聚焦小分子药物设计，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，与课题匹配度有限。
abstract: Transcriptional enhancer associate domain (TEAD) transcription factors serve as the essential DNA-binding effectors that transduce Hippo pathway signaling into transcriptional programs. In mammals, the four TEAD homologues (TEAD1-4) primarily function through association with the transcriptional coactivators YAP and TAZ. Hyperactivation of the YAP/TAZ-TEAD axis confers hyperproliferative, pro-survival, and migratory phenotypes, a hallmark of numerous solid malignancies, including gastric, colorectal, breast, prostate, and mesothelioma cancers. Consequently, TEAD represents a compelling yet pharmacologically challenging target for anticancer intervention. Contemporary TEAD modulators have evolved into three principal modalities: inhibitors disrupting the YAP/TAZ-TEAD protein-protein interaction (PPI), ligands occupying the conserved TEAD palmitoylation pocket, and proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) mediating TEAD degradation. This review provides a comprehensive overview of TEAD modulators disclosed since 2021, emphasizing the underlying medicinal chemistry strategies. Beyond mere enumeration of bioactive scaffolds, we trace the evolution of representative hits into optimized leads and clinical candidates, delineate how novel chemotypes alter binding conformations in crystallographic and docking studies, and correlate these structural modifications with biochemical, cellular, and in vivo efficacy. Furthermore, we critically assess the current clinical landscape, address persistent challenges regarding safety and selectivity, and outline emerging technological opportunities in TEAD-directed drug discovery.
abstract_zh: 转录增强子关联域（TEAD）转录因子作为必需的DNA结合效应器，将Hippo通路信号转导为转录程序。在哺乳动物中，四种TEAD同源物（TEAD1-4）主要通过与其转录共激活因子YAP和TAZ的关联发挥功能。YAP/TAZ-TEAD轴的过度激活赋予细胞过度增殖、促生存和迁移表型，这是多种实体恶性肿瘤（包括胃癌、结直肠癌、乳腺癌、前列腺癌和间皮瘤）的标志特征。因此，TEAD代表了一个具有吸引力但在药理学上具有挑战性的抗癌干预靶点。当代TEAD调节剂已演变为三种主要模式：破坏YAP/TAZ-TEAD蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）的抑制剂、占据保守TEAD棕榈酰化口袋的配体，以及介导TEAD降解的蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs）。本综述全面概述了自2021年以来公开的TEAD调节剂，重点强调其潜在的药物化学策略。除了简单列举生物活性骨架外，我们追踪了代表性先导化合物向优化先导物和临床候选药物的演变过程，阐明了新型化学型如何改变晶体学和对接研究中的结合构象，并将这些结构修饰与生化、细胞和体内疗效相关联。此外，我们批判性地评估了当前临床格局，解决了关于安全性和选择性的持续挑战，并概述了TEAD导向药物发现中新兴的技术机遇。
